name: Airwallex
description: Airwallex lets agents read balances and transactions, build cashflow reports, create beneficiaries, and issue cards in the production account of the signed-in user. Each user signs in to their own Airwallex account through the browser.

prompts.text: What are my balances in each currency today?
Build a cashflow report for last month.
Which cards had the most spend this quarter?

apps.name: Airwallex
apps.description: Balances, transactions, reports, beneficiaries, and cards, over Airwallex's MCP server with browser sign-in.
